rule.rule: Retain final candidate only if all prespecified comparison guards pass; otherwise roll back to weighted_short_gap. No alternate mixture, decoder tuning or training. Missing/invalid cells block decision rather than being dropped.
rule.guard_scope: Each of 3 cohorts x 6 scenarios x 2 references, separately; never average natural and stress together.
rule.diagnostic_scope: Pooled all18, natural and original blind scenarios, both references. VV diagnostics reported separately; no fabricated target-equivalence assumption.
rule.rationale: Conservative release-regression policy, not a hypothesis-test noninferiority margin. Reuse existing mean/macro/worst guards; add class and gap-error safeguards before any new-candidate audit outcomes. No arbitrary +0.02 improvement requirement. Heavy VV stress is deliberately a conservative veto even if not target calibrated.
